prerequisites: Second study section achieved (at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section must be proven).
The practical internship has already been completed.

learning_outcomes.text: Reflect on their own project experiences in relation to those of other students.
Objectively assess their presentation performance through the feedback of other participants.
Deepen and secure their insights through moderated discussion, guidance, and advice.
Connect their practical experiences with theoretical knowledge.
Acquire in-depth knowledge about the variety of possible solution approaches to typical technical and methodical problems.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of topics in short presentations (min. 15 to max. 20 minutes each)
Subsequent discussion of the content and statements of the presentation
Subsequent discussion of the presenter's delivery
Allowing and accepting criticism of oneself
assessment_rules: To successfully participate in the course, each participant must give a short presentation (minimum 15 to maximum 20 minutes). The assessment is 'with success' or 'without success'.
bibliography: BEUSHAUSEN, Ulla, 2023. Sicher und frei reden: Sprechängste erfolgreich abbauen - Trainingsprogramm mit 6 Bausteinen. 5. Auflage. München: Ernst Reinhardt Verlag. ISBN 978-3-497-03206-8
